newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Shenzhen targets 15 pct rise in GDP in '97.
newsitem.headline: China's Shenzhen targets 15 pct rise in GDP in '97.

text.p: China's booming southern city of Shenzhen has targeted an increase of 15 percent in its gross domestic product this year, the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Daily said on Wednesday.
This would put the local GDP at 112 billion yuan ($13.49 billion), the newspaper said, quoting the city's domestic economic and social development plan for this year.
Total foreign trade for Shenzhen was expected to reach $40 billion, up 3.3 percent from 1996. Exports would reach $22 billion, up 3.8 percent, it said.
